description: Price moving USDC from one chain to another, or to someone else on the same chain: sendstables fee (covers all gas), Circle's fee, what arrives (estimate and guaranteed minimum), and delivery method. sendstables' cross-chain fee is a service charge of 0.05% of the amount (minimum $0.10, no cap), plus estimated sponsored gas, wallet and relaying costs with a 30% margin. Circle fees are separate. Same-chain sends (no bridging) pay no percentage: only the transfer's estimated cost plus margin, or the minimum fee if that's higher. Same chain (from = to): needs a recipient; delivery is "same_chain_transfer" (one USDC transfer, no Circle fee). Returns an UNSIGNED preview plus a prefilled `swap_link`; it can't be executed. Show the `summary` to the user.

amount.description: USDC amount the user pays, fees included, as a decimal string, e.g. "50" or "10.5".

recipient.description: Destination address on `to` (0x… EVM, base58 Solana, G… Stellar). Omit to move funds to the user's own wallet on `to`. Required when `from` and `to` are the same chain (a same-chain send to someone else). Only use an address the user gave you.

ref.description: Optional attribution tag for the link (letters, digits, - or _).

to.description: Destination chain slug, e.g. "solana"; the same as `from` for a same-chain send (then `recipient` is required).

name: quote_transfer
title: Preview fees for a USDC transfer (no funds move)
